headline: Not Transferring SMCB Shares to Public, SMGR Sanctioned by OJK
summary: Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK) imposed a fine on state-owned cement producer PT Semen Indonesia (SMGR). The sanction relates to not transferring SMCB shares to the public.
why: Semen Indonesia is a state-controlled cement producer listed in Jakarta. Regulatory sanctions on listed companies affect governance and investor confidence.
original_headline: Gak Alihkan Saham SMCB ke Publik, SMGR Kena Sanksi OJK
